Author: efokschaner
Name: Mod Association Analyzer
Punchline: See which Glamourer designs reference each Penumbra mod.
Description: Cross-references your Penumbra mod list against the Mod Associations stored in your Glamourer designs, so you can see which designs use a given mod. Read-only; reads data over public IPC and makes no changes to either plugin. Open with /modassoc.
